 Charlie Puth & Ellie Goulding To Make India Debut At Johnnie & Co. Festival In Mumbai In 2027
 Charlie Puth will make his India debut alongside Ellie Goulding at the inaugural Johnnie & Co. Festival in Mumbai.
 by Tanvi Shrivastava 
 Updated: November 20, 2026 5:18 PM 
 Share 
 Cover Image Courtesy: Instagram/charlieputh 
 American singer-songwriter Charlie Puth is set to perform in India for the first time. The four-time Grammy-nominated artist will headline the inaugural Johnnie & Co. Festival alongside English singer Ellie Goulding in Mumbai on February 13, 2027. Scroll down to learn more.
 Charlie Puth To Make India Debut In Mumbai
 The one-day music festival will take place at Mahalaxmi Racecourse and is expected to draw over 35,000 fans. It marks the launch of Johnnie & Co., a new cultural platform by Johnnie Walker Luxe Blended Water that aims to bring together music, sport and fashion through live events and creative collaborations. Puth’s India debut comes after the release of his new album, Whatever’s Clever . He is known for popular tracks such as ‘Attention’, ‘We Don’t Talk Anymore’ and ‘See You Again’. Goulding will join him as the main support act, bringing some of her best-known songs, including ‘Love Me Like You Do’, ‘Burn’ and ‘Lights’. The first lineup also features Indian artists Kayan, Taba Chake, Mali and Gini. More performers are expected to be announced in the coming weeks.
 Also Read:  Kareena &; Hrithik Reunite After 25 Yrs As Airbnb Brings K3G’s Raichand House To Life In Mumbai 
 The festival is being produced and promoted by Team Innovation and co-powered by HSBC. According to the organisers, the event will bring international performers and Indian musicians together on one stage. Puth said he was looking forward to performing in India for the first time and experiencing the energy of Indian audiences. He also shared that he was excited to play some of his favourite songs at the Mumbai show. Ellie Goulding’s set will feature a selection of her popular hits, while the Indian artists on the lineup will bring their own sounds to the festival.
 Johnnie & Co. Festival Tickets, Dates And Venue
 Tickets for the Johnnie & Co. Festival will be available exclusively through BookMyShow. HSBC customers will get access to a pre-sale from November 23 to November 24, 2026. General ticket sales will open on November 25. The festival is part of a larger cultural programme planned by Johnnie & Co. for 2027. The platform aims to bring together creators, athletes, designers and music fans through collaborations across music, sport and fashion.
 Also Read:  Four Seasons Hotel Mumbai Wins Michelin Key For Its Contemporary Luxury Experience 
 Its sporting initiatives include the Johnnie & Co. Padel Jam, organised in partnership with 7Padel by MS Dhoni in Mumbai. The exhibition match featured Ibrahim Ali Khan and Rhea Chakraborty. The partnership is expected to extend to select 7Padel clubs and tournaments, with more collaborations across other cultural spaces planned during the year.
 Where:  K K Road, Royal Western India Turf Club, Mahalakshmi, Mumbai
 Date:  Saturday, February 13, 2027
 FAQs
 When is Charlie Puth performing in India for the first time?
 Charlie Puth will make his India debut on February 13, 2027, at the Johnnie & Co. Festival in Mumbai.
 Which artists will perform at the Johnnie & Co. Festival?
 The lineup includes Charlie Puth, Ellie Goulding, Kayan, Taba Chake, Mali and Gini. More artists are expected to be announced.
 Where will the Johnnie & Co. Festival take place?
 The festival will be held at Mahalaxmi Racecourse in Mumbai.
